reasoning: By the Pigeonhole Principle, it is impossible to place 18 pigeons into 17 holes with each hole containing at most one pigeon. The maximum capacity is 17 pigeons (17 holes × 1 pigeon each), but we need to place 18 pigeons. At least one hole would be forced to contain 2 or more pigeons, violating the constraint. This problem is UNSATISFIABLE.
